summary: The 30-year Treasury yield hit 5.2%, its highest since 2007, as unsustainable fiscal concerns and Iran war inflation fears drove a sustained bond rout. Markets caught a partial bid Wednesday after Trump claimed U.S.-Iran peace talks are in "the final stages," pushing WTI nearly $10 lower to $98, but Iranian leadership has yet to signal any willingness to deal.
tweet: Iran war oil shock has the 30-year yield at a 19-year high near 5.2% — partial ceasefire optimism offered bonds a brief reprieve Wednesday, but the inflation-rate-hike fear trade remains firmly in control.
